neighbours.label: ' since' used as a causal conjunction ('because'), weakly also the space token before a digit argument in code
fire: We cancelled the picnic, since the forecast promised heavy storms.
She took the train, since her car was still in the garage.
The meeting was moved online, since half the team was travelling.
He skipped dessert, since he had already eaten too much bread.
They hired a guide, since nobody in the group knew the trails.
I left the window open, since the room felt very stuffy.
The shop closed early, since the owner had a family event.
Our results are preliminary, since the sample was quite small.
